text:
Large oval bowl, roughly 20+ cm. It holds diced chicken, likely around 200 g, plus greens (arugula, spinach) and some broccoli, around 80 g together.

- Chicken: about 200 g × 1.65 kcal/g ≈ 330 kcal
- Greens and broccoli: ≈ 25 kcal
- Dressing: none visible, but a little oil is possible, so I added about 30 kcal.

That gives about 385 kcal, which I rounded to 380.
